payload.name: Extract New Activity Intentions and Tryouts
payload.description: Use during extraction when a speaker expresses interest in, plans to try, or states they are trying a new hobby or activity, including in reply to a suggestion.
content: During extraction, if a speaker explicitly says they are considering, planning, or starting a new hobby or activity, create a candidate memory for that activity with any stated timeframe.
Use memory kind 'event' when the speaker states they will try or are trying it; otherwise use 'preference' or 'state' for interest alone.
Do not skip such statements because they are replies, small talk, or acknowledgments; treat the speaker's own stated intention as sufficient evidence.
Capture only the activity and facts explicitly stated; do not infer acceptance of an unmentioned suggestion, and stop once the activity is captured.
During CRUD, if a matching memory for the same activity already exists, MERGE or UPDATE it instead of creating a duplicate.

solves: The construction agent sometimes fails to extract a speaker's own adoption of a new hobby or activity when it appears in casual replies to suggestions, treating the message as small talk or as belonging only to the other speaker's offer. This skill ensures explicit intentions to try or take up an activity become durable memories.
